description: Buildings within a radius (max 500 m) of a point in France, from the IGN BD TOPO building layer. Each building has GeoJSON polygon geometry, height (m), floors, dwellings, use, nature and construction dates. Reports the total matched and flags truncation. Use for "buildings within 200 m of X" and GeoJSON export of them.

include_geometry.description: Include polygon geometry (default true). Set false for attributes only.

name: fr_buildings_near
